en.heroHeadline: Phoenix AC repair — fast, fair, guaranteed
en.heroSub: Your AC quit in July? Desert Comfort shows up same day, diagnoses the real problem, and gets you cooling again — all for one flat price with no surprises.
en.about: Desert Comfort HVAC has been keeping Phoenix cool since 2011. We're a team of EPA 608 and NATE-certified technicians who believe in honest diagnoses, upfront pricing, and getting it right the first time. We service all brands — Trane, Carrier, Lennox, Rheem — and we're Factory Authorized dealers for heating and heat-pump systems. When your AC fails, you get a real person on the phone and a tech within 4 hours.

services.name: AC repair & emergency
services.blurb: Not cooling, running non-stop, or dead? Same-day diagnosis, flat rate, one-year warranty.
services.description: AC acting up? We diagnose the real problem — compressor, capacitor, refrigerant, airflow — and fix it without the guesswork.
services.pricingSignal: Diagnostic: $89. Repair labor: $150–$400. Emergency calls same rate, 24/7.
symptoms: Unit cycles on and off constantly
Loud or grinding noise from outside

process.title: Quick check
process.description: We inspect the thermostat, outdoor unit, and airflow. Takes 15–20 min.

process.title: Diagnosis
process.description: We tell you exactly what's broken and show you repair options with pricing.

process.title: Repair
process.description: Fix it on the spot, usually same day. We test cooling, calibrate, and clean up.

process.title: Warranty
process.description: One-year warranty on parts and labor. If it fails due to our work, we fix it free.

services.name: AC installation & replacement
services.blurb: New system or upgrade? Financing available, efficiency rebates, heat-pump options.
services.description: Thinking about a new AC or heat pump? We size, install, and set up efficiency programs.
services.pricingSignal: System + install: $3,000–$8,000 depending on size & brand. Financing available. Free quotes.

services.name: Maintenance & tune-ups
services.blurb: Spring prep before summer? Annual maintenance keeps your system running and warranties valid.
services.description: Pre-summer check ensures your system is ready for the heat and catches small issues before they fail.

services.name: Heating & furnace repair
services.blurb: Furnace won't ignite or heat dead zones? Phoenix winters are mild, but when you need heat, we're here.
services.description: Winter issues are rare in Phoenix, but when they hit, same-day service.

es.tagline: Reparación e instalación de aire acondicionado, con licencia y local
es.heroHeadline: Reparación de aire acondicionado en Phoenix — rápido, justo y garantizado
es.heroSub: ¿Tu aire acondicionado se apagó en julio? Desert Comfort llega el mismo día, diagnostica el verdadero problema y te devuelve la refrigeración — todo por un precio fijo sin sorpresas.
es.about: Desert Comfort HVAC mantiene Phoenix fresco desde 2011. Somos un equipo de técnicos certificados EPA 608 y NATE que creemos en diagnósticos honestos, precios transparentes y hacer el trabajo bien a la primera. Reparamos todas las marcas — Trane, Carrier, Lennox, Rheem — y somos distribuidores autorizados de fábrica para sistemas de calefacción y bombas de calor. Cuando tu aire se descompone, hablas con una persona real y un técnico llega en 4 horas.
